title: Archivio Tommaso Campanella (ATC)
notes: Archivio Tommaso Campanella (ATC), part of the ILIESI 'Archivio dei filosofi del Rinascimento' (with the Bruno and Vanini archives). It gathers the writings of Tommaso Campanella (1568-1639) in text-with-facsimile form, mostly following modern critical editions (for example by Luigi Firpo and Germana Ernst), together with a detailed chronology, a census of early Campanella prints in Italian and foreign libraries, documents, bibliographic notes, studies, images and an ethical-political lexicon. The texts are also available as TEI XML files. Run by ILIESI-CNR (Rome) under the scientific direction of Eugenio Canone; the site is dedicated to Germana Ernst and its pages carry copyright dates 2009-2020. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
